body:
Conflict fixed (the review's only request): merged current main into the branch.

- `crates/cl/src/cl/mod.rs`: kept both `mod rotary;` (this PR) and `pub mod text;` (#279).
- Merging also surfaced a semantic conflict git didn't flag: three sim tests main gained since this branch started (`stock_dual` #280, `hidden_rest_banded` #282, `stock_lathe_blade` #200) build `cl::Move` without the new `rotary` field; they now say `rotary: None`.

Re-gated on the merged tree: whole workspace builds (`cargo test --workspace --no-run`); cl lib 29, the five `headless_bin` suites, app `c_axis_live` 4 / `rotary_letter` 3 / `rotary_verify` 9 / `machine` 32, post suites, sim `stock_dual` 5 / `stock_lathe_blade` 5 / `hidden_rest_banded` 5 / `stock_rotary` 2 all pass; clippy `-D warnings` on cl, sim, motion, post, app, geometry, tools clean. Flagging ready again for a fresh review of this head.
